verdict.rationale: Vast.ai documents overlay networks that give instances on different machines in the same physical LAN a private virtual LAN for multi-node PyTorch/NCCL training (vast-ai-docs-12, vast-ai-docs-18). Provisioning is self-serve: sign up, add credit by card or crypto, and rent instances via the console or CLI, with multi-GPU offers searchable (vast-ai-docs-42, vast-ai-docs-53, vast-ai-gh-1). Multi-node is only possible when machines share one host's LAN, there is no turnkey cluster product, and community reports of inconsistent bandwidth temper confidence (vast-ai-comm-10). Missing for 10: documented fast interconnect (InfiniBand/RDMA or interconnect bandwidth specs), a first-class multi-node cluster provisioning workflow, multi-node beyond a single host's physical LAN, and independent corroboration of distributed-training performance.
